$comment: One round, one falsifiable claim, one receipt. This round pays the last round's obligation #3 (repair check_flags) and finds the defect was three defects, only one of them in check_flags.

not a claim that a signature is a name: gzip -t+gunzip -t is not the word gzip
not a claim about rooms with no checker: an object no program can check has the empty signature and is reported as such
not learned: nothing is stored between runs, and the identical witness sets on two rooms are why

load_bearing_primary.why: OSWORLD_2_1_PARTIAL_GE_81_8 is the obligation a model-free action repertoire has to move: it is the one open row about DOING THINGS ON A COMPUTER, and its own failure axes (lost constraints, skipped verification) are what the goal check and the target-kind need are built to make mechanical. This round does not claim the row; it prices the mechanism that would have to carry it, on the only substrate available here (this sandbox's published pages).

agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE was priced first: patching `check_flags()`'s prose test in place is the incumbent, and it is what the last round's obligation literally asked for -- it is done here and it is measurably insufficient, because a prose test cannot decide whether a flag writes and cannot decide whether a cited check can tell one object from another. ADAPT: a blacklist of destroyers is the obvious published answer and it is the same design (a written list read against a machine nobody has seen), so it is included only as the second line of defence behind an execution test. COMPOSE: the guide already computes object kinds for every step and already runs programs against the room; what did not exist is a certification of a check by RUNNING it, and a status that compares content instead of kinds. Both are composed from what the tree already has.
agent_orientation.route_class_note: SYNTHESIZE_NEW_PRIMITIVE applies to `certified_checks` and `_digest`: the repository had no test that a check is read-only, and no status field that could see an overwrite.
agent_orientation.progress_class_note: The claim falsified is the guide's own: `check_flags()` called 2,319 flags read-only and 16 of them write; `compile_step` published a check on every step and nothing ran it; and `run()` reported a destroyed object as ACCEPTED_INERT because it compared kinds. The frontier narrows to: a citation must be executed and must be derived from the room, which 3 of 87 edges can satisfy today -- named, measured, not built.

action_summary: Pays obligation #3 of A_TYPE_YOU_WROTE_IS_A_TYPE_YOU_GUESS: check_flags() certified shred -v as a read-only check. Measured: 16 of 2,319 certified flags change bytes; 281 of 370 citations accept every object (249 are --help); 8 of 8 cited-check probes accept a decoy of the same kind; 7 of 8 accepted destroyers are reported ACCEPTED_INERT. Repairs check_flags (vocabulary + named destroyers), adds an executed certification test, and makes run() compare content instead of kinds. Refuses to claim the citation is repaired: 3 of 87 edges have any flag that discriminates.
